name: ldg-check-use-on-the-job
description: Drafts the check on use some weeks after a programme, with a short anonymous follow-up, the group-level work measures to read beside it, a consent-first conversation guide for volunteers, and a barrier list that names who could remove each barrier. Use for "run ldg-check-use-on-the-job", "training follow-up survey", "level 3 evaluation", "behaviour change after training", "did the training work", "30 day follow-up", "training transfer survey", "did anyone actually use it", part of The Complete Claude Guide for L&D Pack by 90n.
